nodes.label: File Node Resolution
nodes.rationale: Keep the same relative paths that the canvas uses inside your vault, so that file nodes resolve.

nodes.label: greytHR Onboarding Wizard Flow
nodes.rationale: A structured 6-stage wizard flow designed to collect comprehensive employee information during onboarding, tracking progress through distinct stages from Personal Information to Attachments.

nodes.label: Personal Information Form Layout
nodes.rationale: A 3-column form layout optimizing space utilization while grouping related fields like personal contacts, demographics, and physical metrics together for easier scanning.

nodes.label: Impulsive Web Corporate Branding
nodes.rationale: White-labeled deployment of the greytHR portal featuring the 'Impulsive Web' corporate identity and logo in the header.

nodes.label: Employee Profile Summary Header Card
nodes.rationale: A summary card displayed at the top of the onboarding interface to maintain context of the current employee (John Doe, ID: IW-024) and key details like location and contact.

nodes.label: Multi-Step Onboarding Wizard Pattern
nodes.rationale: Guides the user sequentially through 6 onboarding steps (Personal Info, Previous Employment, Accounts/Statutory, Family Details, Nomination, Attachments) to structure a complex data entry process.

nodes.label: Previous Employment Dynamic Form Layout
nodes.rationale: Allows adding multiple historical employment records sequentially, capturing metadata like designation, salary, dates, and company address.

nodes.label: Static Profile Summary Card
nodes.rationale: Displays read-only core employee identity details (avatar, name, Emp ID, Location, Designation, Department) persistently at the top to maintain user context.

nodes.label: Impulsive Web Portal Interface
nodes.rationale: An employee self-service portal designed for centralizing employee profiles, personal information, and employment documents.

nodes.label: Employee Profile Summary Header
nodes.rationale: A card-based summary layout that sits at the top of the profile view to present critical identity info (Avatar, Employee ID, Location, point of contact) cleanly.

nodes.label: Information Directory Sidebar
nodes.rationale: A left-hand navigation menu mapping out sections of employee records, grouping extensive forms into digestible categories to improve completion rates and discoverability.

nodes.label: Personal Information Summary Grid
nodes.rationale: A grid-based read-only profile directory mapping field keys (e.g. Blood Group, DOB, email) with empty states indicated by a em-dash, keeping a structured profile layout.

nodes.label: Progressive Information Collection Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Encourages users to complete profile information sections iteratively. Uses contextual empty states and explicit edit actions rather than showing all fields as active inputs at once, reducing cognitive load.
